material_findings.title: Parsed receipt equality admits bool/integer type-changing edits
material_findings.concrete_counterexample: Use the actual shape of an accepted export record cached after the background CLI reader. While Window.opened is queued, rewrite only export/export.json export_accepted from JSON true to JSON1. Python dict equality considers the current integer1 equal to the cached BooleanTrue, so read_record(...) != exported is false. review_export.evidence() excludes root export.json, and source/settings/target files remain unchanged. check_open_export_material therefore returns and the opener runs. The central reader explicitly requires export_accepted is True and would reject this now-malformed receipt. Changing schema1 to Booleantrue is another equal-under-Python edit.
material_findings.impact: A changed and invalid current export receipt can pass the callback's material guard and be presented as checked. The candidate itself remains unchanged in this counterexample; this does not demonstrate Native/routing acceptance forgery.
material_findings.minimal_fix: Compare existing canonical JSON representations of current and cached records, rather than Python dict equality, so Boolean/integer types remain distinct. The existing floor_route.canonical helper suffices with the current strict read_record parser. Alternatively capture/check the exact raw receipt hash in the existing background check. Keep the existing evidence witness and cancellation precedence.
material_findings.focused_regression: Create the same actual-flow queued-open fixture with a cached export_accepted:true/schema1 receipt. After successful inspect_path, rewrite only export_accepted to1, and separately schema totrue, using valid JSON. Deliver the extracted Window.opened callback with a mocked opener. Require no launch, cleared positive state and retained refusal. The present receipt mutation test writes invalid JSON bytes, which does not cover this coercive-equality case.
material_findings.observation_status: Source-derived concrete counterexample; not executed by this read-only reviewer.

accepted_closures: flow.fresh immediately before the opener fixes the reproduced saved-source/settings queued-callback gap and uses existing refusal handling.
Cancel, closing and existing error branches precede freshness/material work and opening.
The existing review_export.evidence file/directory witness covers changed candidate/project, added rule files and other direct export evidence without Native/CLI or a new audit framework.

The focused tests use real temporary Workflow/source/settings/export material with a mocked background CLI/opener. New source/settings and candidate/new-rule/corrupt-receipt mutations, unchanged open, and cancellation precedence are covered. They remain authored controls rather than Native/GUI qualification.
limits: After the type-equality fix, this remains bounded callback-time source/settings and direct export material consistency. It does not atomically bind external editor reads, revalidate every bound original/review/routing tree or rerun Native acceptance. Existing background semantic reader remains authority. Shared byte inventory has its existing256MiB/12000file bounds and is not constant-time.
review_boundary: Read-only exact patch/helper/tests and retained focused log inspection only; no source edits, imports, tests, Native/JVM, network or recursive delegation. The only write is this review JSON.
